body.name: \(\mathcal C_n\)
body.construction: For \(q\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}\), draw \(\xi_q\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}N(0,1)\), compute \(W_n^\xi=\max_{k\in\mathcal K_n}|\sum_{q=(u,v)\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}\widehat c_{kq}\widehat\sigma_u\xi_q/\widehat s_k|\), take its conditional \(1-\alpha\) quantile \(c_{1-\alpha,n}\), and report \(\mathcal C_{n,k}=[\widehat\tau_k\pm c_{1-\alpha,n}\widehat s_k]\).
